cause: The home-summary renderer reused an empty-object fallback intended for exception safety as though it were an observed Runtime snapshot, converting missing state into factual-looking healthy values.
prevention: Suppress every state-derived verdict, summary, strip, and flow tile while Runtime state is absent; retain the neutral freshness clock and existing error signal, then cover delayed success, HTTP failure, and network abort in desktop and mobile browser regressions.
summary: The null-safe cockpit path rendered absent Runtime state as open zero, WIP zero of three, passing gates, idle agents, and zero or unknown flow tiles before a delayed or failed state request completed.
title: Keep pre-load cockpit summaries neutral
